description: Add a grocery item to a grocery list (adds to existing quantity if item already exists). Quantity can be an integer or string like '1 kilo', '4 liters', or '-2 kilos' to subtract.

grocery_list_name.description: Name of the grocery list (optional, defaults to default list)

item_name.description: Name of the grocery item to add

quantity.description: Quantity to add (default: '1'). Can be a number or string with unit like '1 kilo', '4 liters'. Use negative values like '-2 kilos' to subtract.

name: add_grocery

description: Add a meal to the meal plan

date.description: Date in flexible format - accepts "YYYY-MM-DD", "dd mmm", "dd mmmm", etc. Optional, defaults to next free day.

meal.description: Meal name for fuzzy matching (optional if meal_id provided)

name: add_meal_to_plan

description: Clear all items from a grocery list

grocery_list_name.description: Name of the grocery list (optional, defaults to default list)

name: clear_grocery_list

description: Create a new recipe in Paprika. Auto-generates professional AI food photography (~$0.002 per image using Replicate). Set generate_image=false to disable.

description.description: Optional recipe description. TIP: Add brief ingredients at the start for quick scanning (format: 'Ingredients: item1, item2, item3\n\n[rest of description]')

generate_image.description: Auto-generate AI food photography (default: true). Disable to skip image generation.

name: create_recipe

description: Delete a recipe from Paprika by moving it to trash. REQUIRES CONFIRMATION. Provide either uid or title to identify the recipe, then call again with confirm=true to proceed with deletion.

confirm.description: Must be set to true to confirm deletion. Without this, only shows what will be deleted.

title.description: The title of the recipe to delete (optional if uid provided)

uid.description: The UID of the recipe to delete (optional if title provided)

name: delete_recipe

ingredients.description: List of ingredients to search for

match_mode.description: Match mode: 'all' (recipe must contain ALL ingredients) or 'any' (at least one ingredient)

description: Filter recipes by time constraints (prep time, cook time, or total time)

max_total_time.description: Maximum total time (prep + cook) in minutes

name: filter_recipes_by_time

description: Get all groceries from a grocery list

grocery_list_name.description: Name of the grocery list (optional, defaults to default list)

name: get_groceries

description: Get a specific grocery item by name from a grocery list

grocery_list_name.description: Name of the grocery list (optional, defaults to default list)

name: get_grocery

description: Get all grocery list names from Paprika
name: get_grocery_lists

description: List recipes from Paprika with pagination, sorting, filtering, and field selection for large collections

exclude_fields.description: Omit specified fields (e.g., ['directions', 'notes']). include_fields takes precedence.

filter_query.description: Quick text search across name, ingredients, and description

include_fields.description: Only return specified fields (e.g., ['name', 'uid', 'ingredients']). UID always included.

limit.description: Maximum number of recipes to return (default: 100, max: 500)

offset.description: Number of recipes to skip (for pagination, default: 0)

name: list_recipes

description: Read complete details of a single recipe by UID or title

title.description: The exact title of the recipe to read (case-sensitive)

uid.description: The UID of the recipe to read (preferred if both uid and title are provided)

name: read_recipe

description: Regenerate AI food photography for an existing recipe with optional custom styling instructions. Cost: ~$0.002 per generation. Requires REPLICATE_API_TOKEN to be configured.

custom_instructions.description: Optional styling instructions (e.g., 'rustic style, less cream visible', 'darker lighting, wooden background')

uid.description: The UID of the recipe to regenerate image for

name: regenerate_recipe_image

description: Remove a meal from the meal plan. If no arguments provided, removes meal on latest date in mealplan

date.description: Date in flexible format (optional, defaults to last day with matching meal)

name: remove_meal_from_plan

description: Search for recipes by text query across multiple fields (name, ingredients, description)

query.description: Search query to find in recipes

name: search_recipes

description: Update a recipe by providing only the fields you want to change. All fields except 'uid' are optional. Omitted fields remain unchanged.

description.description: Recipe description (optional). TIP: Add brief ingredients at the start for quick scanning (format: 'Ingredients: item1, item2, item3\n\n[rest of description]')

uid.description: The UID of the recipe to update

name: update_recipe
